title: Decoding microglial metabolic cell death and PANoptosis hub genes in subacute phase of traumatic brain injury: a multi-omics and experimental validation study.
authors: Wu, Zhe; Yang, Bao-Ya; Lai, Jin-Qing; Lin, Shi-Hong; Lin, Long; Chen, Jian-Long; Pan, Jia-Xiang; Ruan, Yao-Xin; Chen, Xiang-Rong
journal: Apoptosis : an international journal on programmed cell death
one_liner_zh: 该文通过多组学与实验验证鉴定TBI亚急性期小胶质细胞PANoptosis和代谢性细胞死亡枢纽基因，并用AlphaFold3和EMSA验证转录因子Batf/Irf8与靶基因DNA结合构象，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白-DNA互作建模且方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Microglia play a central regulatory role in neuroinflammation and metabolic disturbances during the subacute phase of traumatic brain injury (TBI). PANoptosis and metabolic cell death are key drivers of TBI pathological progression; however, the key regulatory genes governing these processes within microglia remain unclear. Bulk and single-cell RNA-seq datasets from mice with subacute TBI were retrieved from the NCBI GEO database. Seven hub genes associated with PANoptosis and metabolic cell death were identified through weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) and maximum group centricity (MCC) algorithms. The occurrence of PANoptosis and metabolic cell death, was validated in a controlled cortical impact (CCI) mouse model. ChEA3 predicted that Batf and Irf8 are common transcription factors regulating these hub genes. Their binding conformations were validated using both AlphaFold3 and electrophoretic mobility shift assay (EMSA), suggesting that hub genes across distinct cell death pathways may be co-regulated. Single-cell RNA-seq data revealed differential expression of the hub genes Lgals3, Gbp2, Capg, and Timp1 in microglia. Monocle2 was used to analyze microglial developmental trajectories, and metabolic flux algorithms were applied to predict metabolic states. Integrated multidimensional evidence ultimately identified the disease-associated microglial subset MG3. Experimental evidence confirmed that these four hub genes are upregulated in microglia, with Lgals3 and Capg exhibiting distinct expression levels across different cell death modalities. These results suggest the potential existence of shared nodal molecules that interconnect metabolic cell death and PANoptosis, thereby providing new potential therapeutic targets for TBI that warrant further investigation.
abstract_zh: 小胶质细胞在创伤性脑损伤（TBI）亚急性期的神经炎症和代谢紊乱中发挥核心调控作用。PANoptosis和代谢性细胞死亡是TBI病理进展的关键驱动因素；然而，小胶质细胞中调控这些过程的关键调控基因仍不清楚。从NCBI GEO数据库获取了亚急性TBI小鼠的批量及单细胞RNA-seq数据集。通过加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）和最大组中心性（MCC）算法，鉴定了七个与PANoptosis和代谢性细胞死亡相关的枢纽基因。在控制性皮质撞击（CCI）小鼠模型中验证了PANoptosis和代谢性细胞死亡的发生。ChEA3预测Batf和Irf8是调控这些枢纽基因的常见转录因子。其结合构象通过AlphaFold3和电泳迁移率变动分析（EMSA）得到验证，提示不同细胞死亡通路中的枢纽基因可能受到协同调控。单细胞RNA-seq数据揭示了枢纽基因Lgals3、Gbp2、Capg和Timp1在小胶质细胞中的差异表达。使用Monocle2分析小胶质细胞发育轨迹，并应用代谢通量算法预测代谢状态。整合多维证据最终确定了疾病相关小胶质细胞亚群MG3。实验证据证实这四个枢纽基因在小胶质细胞中上调，其中Lgals3和Capg在不同细胞死亡模式中表现出显著不同的表达水平。这些结果表明，连接代谢性细胞死亡和PANoptosis的共享节点分子可能存在，从而为TBI提供新的潜在治疗靶点，值得进一步研究。
